records.label: spacr.qt.screens.classifier_evaluation.ClassifierEvaluationScreen.open_cell#2
records.source: The per-key confidences ride along in ``context`` so the receiver can show *why* this order, and the threshold so it can say where the split was made.
records.translation: 每密钥信任在 ``context`` 中沿着,以便接收者可以显示 *为什么* 这个订单,以及阈值,以至于它可以说明分裂是在哪里进行的。

records.context: Explain CV Model reports feature gain, held-out permutation importance and SHAP values for machine-learning classification models trained on measured features.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.classify#3
records.source: Explain CV Model reports feature gain, held-out permutation importance and SHAP values for classifiers trained on measured features.
records.translation: 解释 CV 模型报告的特征获益,持有转换的重要性和 SHAP 值的机械学习分类模型训练在测量特征。

records.context: Everything on this screen is recorded. A ledger is written beside each artefact (see :mod:`spacr.curation`), so a hand-edited mask can be told apart from a segmented one later.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.curate#2
records.source: Everything on this screen is recorded. A ledger is written beside each artefact (see :mod:`spacr.curation`), so a hand-edited mask can be told apart from a segmented one later.
records.translation: 此筛选上的所有内容都被录制. 每件物品旁边写着一张标签(见 :mod:`spacr.curation`),所以手编辑的掩膜可以与分割的后面分开。

records.context: Purely a view operation — no re-query — so it stays instant on a table with hundreds of feature columns. An empty string restores every column.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser.DbBrowserScreen.set_column_filter#1
records.source: Purely a view operation — no re-query — so it stays instant on a table with hundreds of feature columns. An empty string restores every column.
records.translation: 纯粹是一个视图操作 - 没有重新要求 - 因此它暂时留在一张桌子上,有数百个特征列。

records.context: Chunks are fetched with *every* column, and the column search only changes which of them are mapped into the view. Typing in the search box therefore never re-queries the database — which is what makes it usable on a table with 500 feature columns.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.db_browser.PreviewModel#4
records.source: Chunks are fetched with *every* column, and the column search only changes which of them are mapped into the view. Typing in the search box therefore never re-queries the database — which is what makes it usable on a table with 500 feature columns.
records.translation: Chunks 用 *每个* 列,而列搜索只会改变其中哪个被地图到视图中. 因此,在搜索框中输入,从来没有重新查询数据库 - 这就是它在 500 个特征列的表中可用的。

records.context: **What it is for.** Giving every object a vector that no label went into. The measured panel says how big a cell is and how bright each stain was; an embedding describes what the cell looks like, in a few hundred numbers a pretrained backbone produces without being told what to look for. It complements the panel rather than replacing it: a phenotype that no measured column captures can still be represented in the vector.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#3
records.source: **What it is for.** Giving every object a vector that no label went into. The measured panel says how big a cell is and how bright each stain was; an embedding describes what the cell looks like, in a few hundred numbers a pretrained backbone produces without being told what to look for. It complements the panel rather than replacing it: a phenotype that no measured column captures can still be represented in the vector.
records.translation: **用途。** 为每个对象提供一个未使用任何标签生成的向量。测量面板说明细胞有多大、每种染色有多亮；嵌入则用预训练骨干网络生成的几百个数字描述细胞的外观，而无需告诉它要关注什么。它是对测量面板的补充而不是替代：没有任何测量列能捕获的表型，仍可在向量中得到体现。

records.context: **What to do next.** Treat the columns as a feature source, not as a result. They are consumed exactly as the measured panel is -- a reduction to see whether the objects separate, a regression against the perturbation, a retrieval to find the objects most like one you picked. The screening experiment repeats the corresponding warning under the table: a single dimension is not a phenotype, and these numbers can only be interpreted through an analysis that uses the whole vector.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#6
records.source: **What to do next.** Treat the columns as a feature source, not as a result. They are consumed exactly as the measured panel is -- a reduction to see whether the objects separate, a regression against the perturbation, a retrieval to find the objects most like one you picked. The screen repeats the corresponding warning under the table: a single dimension is not a phenotype, and these numbers can only be interpreted through an analysis that uses the whole vector.
records.translation: **下一步要做什么.** 将列作为特征来源,而不是结果. 它们正如测量面板一样消耗 - 对物体是否分开的减少,对干扰的逆转,对物品最相似于你选择的回收。

records.context: **The channel policy is the first control on the screen.** How channels are combined must not be decided implicitly by whatever the backbone expects. Per-channel encoding keeps the channel in every column name and costs N forward passes; projection mixes the channels into three and costs one. Those produce columns of identical width and dtype that mean entirely different things, so the screen makes the choice explicit and says what each one costs.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#8
records.source: **The channel policy is the first control on the screen.** How channels are combined must not be decided implicitly by whatever the backbone expects. Per-channel encoding keeps the channel in every column name and costs N forward passes; projection mixes the channels into three and costs one. Those produce columns of identical width and dtype that mean entirely different things, so the screen makes the choice explicit and says what each one costs.
records.translation: **通道政策是筛选上的第一个控制。**如何将通道结合起来不应该由任何背景所期望的 implicit 每个通道编码保持通道的每个列名称和成本 N 前进; 投影将频率混为三个,成本一个. 这些产生相同的宽度和d类的列,意味着完全不同的事情,所以筛选做出选择明确,并说每一个成本。

records.context: **The encoder is identified with the checksum of its weights.** The processing session summary carries the model-zoo entry from :func:`spacr.embeddings.encoder_entry` -- backbone, policy and the digest of the weights on this machine -- because two processing sessions' dimension 17 are the same number and not the same thing unless all three match.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings#10
records.source: **The encoder is identified with the checksum of its weights.** The run summary carries the model-zoo entry from :func:`spacr.embeddings.encoder_entry` -- backbone, policy and the digest of the weights on this machine -- because two runs' dimension 17 are the same number and not the same thing unless all three match.
records.translation: **编码器与其权重的检查数量相识。**处理会议总结将模型动物园输入从 :func:`spacr.embeddings.encoder_entry` - 背部,政策和该机器的权重的消化 - 因为两个处理会议的尺寸17是相同的数字,而不是相同的东西,除非所有三个相匹配。

records.context: ``SECTION_DATA``, beside the other things that turn a table into numbers. An embedding is a feature source, not an analysis: it produces columns that the reductions, the regressions and the hit calling then consume exactly as they consume the measured panel.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.embeddings.register#2
records.source: ``SECTION_DATA``, beside the other things that turn a table into numbers. An embedding is a feature source, not an analysis: it produces columns that the reductions, the regressions and the hit calling then consume exactly as they consume the measured panel.
records.translation: ``SECTION_DATA``,除了将图表变成数字的其他事物之外,一个嵌入式是一种特征来源,而不是分析:它产生了减少、退缩和打电话的列,然后就像它们在测量面板中消耗的那样消耗。

records.context: The laboratory microplate drawing is shared where it can be. The square, the constant it is pitched at and the row/column headers come from :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.plate_map_picker` rather than being declared a second time here; the two laboratory microplates had already drifted apart once. What cannot be shared is the well itself, and the difference is functional: the picker's well is a checkable ``QPushButton`` whose checked state IS the selection and which paints itself from a fixed pair of colours, while this one is a ``QLabel`` carrying a role, an edge mark, a name and a condition, painted by the theme through the properties below -- a laboratory microplate map that says what each well holds rather than only whether it is chosen.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.experiment_design#7
records.source: The plate drawing is shared where it can be. The square, the constant it is pitched at and the row/column headers come from :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.plate_map_picker` rather than being declared a second time here; the two plates had already drifted apart once. What cannot be shared is the well itself, and the difference is functional: the picker's well is a checkable ``QPushButton`` whose checked state IS the selection and which paints itself from a fixed pair of colours, while this one is a ``QLabel`` carrying a role, an edge mark, a name and a condition, painted by the theme through the properties below -- a plate map that says what each well holds rather than only whether it is chosen.
records.translation: 实验室微板的绘图是共享的,它可以在哪里. 方形,它是固定在和序列 / 列头来自 :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.plate_map_picker` 而不是被宣布第二次在这里; 两个实验室小板已经分开一次. 什么不能共享是本质本身,而差异是功能性的: 画家的孔是可检查的 ``QPushButton`` 其检查状态是选择的,并从固定颜色,而这个是 ``QLabel`` 携带一个角色,一个边缘标志,一个名字和一个条件,由主题通过下面的属性绘制 - 一个实验室显板地图说,每个人都保持什么,而不是它只是选择的。

records.context: Feature Explorer: rank measured features by how well they separate classes.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.feature_explorer#0
records.source: Feature Explorer: rank measured features by how well they separate classes.
records.translation: 特征探测器:按它们分类的程度排序测量的特征。

records.context: Assembles the ranking panel with the Local Data Filter (so a ranking can be restricted to one plate without leaving the application view) and the formula panel (so a derived feature is ranked alongside the measured ones). records.context: ``False`` runs every table read inline instead of on the job runner's independent execution path. records.source: ``False`` runs every table read inline instead of on the job runner's thread. records.translation: ``False`` 运行每个桌面阅读线,而不是工作运行器的独立执行路径。 一个测试需要在电话后线上的结果; 用户需要窗户来保持绘画,而一个大桌子充电。 工作是相同的方式 - 他们仍然注册,无法阅读的文件仍然通过 :meth:`_on_frame_loaded` 作为 :class:`_Loaded` 携带 ``problem`` 返回 - 所以只有等待不同。

records.context: A child whose ``cell_id`` names no cell is dropped by every join in the codebase. records.label: spacr.qt.screens.lineage#4
records.source: A child whose ``cell_id`` names no cell is dropped by every join in the codebase. It is not noise: it means the nucleus mask found an object the cell mask did not, which is a segmentation disagreement worth looking at. It gets its own list here, with the same double-click-to-open, so these objects can be reviewed without writing SQL.
records.translation: 一个孩子谁的 ``cell_id`` 名称没有细胞被每个加入在代码基础上掉下来. 这不是噪音:这意味着核掩膜发现了一个对象,细胞掩膜没有,这是一个分割分歧值得一看。

records.context: **Normally empty.** The object key carries the object type, so a cell's nucleus 1 and its pathogen 1 are two keys. The check is kept to report a regression in which keys collide again; without it, "opening four objects showed three extracted image regions" would have no explanation on screen.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.lineage.LineageScreen.collision_note#1
records.source: **Normally empty.** The object key carries the object type, so a cell's nucleus 1 and its pathogen 1 are two keys. The check is kept to report a regression in which keys collide again; without it, "opening four objects showed three crops" would have no explanation on screen.
records.translation: **正常空白**对象密钥携带对象类型,所以细胞的细胞核1和其病原体1是两个密钥。

records.context: The de-duplication is on the shared key, which is what the routing contract takes. That key carries the object type, so a cell's nucleus 1 and pathogen 1 stay two keys; if keys ever collide, fewer keys than objects are returned and :meth:`collision_note` reports it on application view.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.lineage.LineageScreen.family_keys#2
records.source: The de-duplication is on the shared key, which is what the routing contract takes. That key carries the object type, so a cell's nucleus 1 and pathogen 1 stay two keys; if keys ever collide, fewer keys than objects are returned and :meth:`collision_note` reports it on screen.
records.translation: 该密钥携带对象类型,因此细胞的细胞核1和病原体1仍然有两个密钥;如果密钥碰撞,则比对象更少的密钥返回,并在应用程序视图上报告 :meth:`collision_note`。

records.source: Interactive editing and curation of segmentation masks.
records.translation: 互动编辑和治疗分割掩膜。

records.context: Make Masks is filed under **Tools** on the home application view and is the manual half of segmentation: it corrects masks a model got wrong, one microscope field of view at a time, and its masthead opens the Cellpose workflows that produced them. :class:`MakeMasksScreen` loads images and labelled masks from ``<folder>/masks`` and saves edited labels as ``uint16`` TIFF files.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#1
records.source: Make Masks is filed under **Tools** on the home screen and is the manual half of segmentation: it corrects masks a model got wrong, one field at a time, and its masthead opens the Cellpose workflows that produced them. :class:`MakeMasksScreen` loads images and labelled masks from ``<folder>/masks`` and saves edited labels as ``uint16`` TIFF files.
records.translation: Make Masks 在主应用程序视图上输入 **Tools** 并是手动分割的一半:它纠正一个模型错误的掩膜,一个显微镜的视野同时,其掩膜头打开了产生它们的 Cellpose 工作流。 :class:`MakeMasksScreen` 从 ``<folder>/masks`` 上加载图像和标签掩膜,并将编辑标签保存为 ``uint16`` TIFF 文件。

records.context: Additional segmentation tools are opened from the masthead in :data:`FOLD_ORDER` through :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.FoldStrip`. **Mask the whole folder** applies Cellpose to every image in the selected folder, while **Save mask** on the Curate page calls :meth:`spacr.curation.MaskCuration.save_mask`. Folded modules retain their existing widgets inside :class:`FoldedModulePanel`.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks#14
records.source: Additional segmentation tools are opened from the masthead in :data:`FOLD_ORDER` through :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.FoldStrip`. **Mask the whole folder** applies Cellpose to every image in the selected folder, while **Save mask** on the Curate page calls :meth:`spacr.curation.MaskCuration.save_mask`. Folded modules retain their existing widgets inside :class:`FoldedModulePanel`.
records.translation: 额外的分割工具从 :data:`FOLD_ORDER` 到 :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.FoldStrip` 打开。 **显示整个文件夹** 适用于选定的文件夹中的每个图像 Cellpose, 而在清洁页面上的 **Save mask** 会调用给 :meth:`spacr.curation.MaskCuration.save_mask`. 包装模块保留现有 widgets 在 :class:`FoldedModulePanel` 中。

records.translation: 将一个选择的区域提取到一个单独的训练视野。

records.context: The two panes are filled BEFORE the mask is touched, and they are filled even when the run found nothing at all. A run that returns an empty mask is exactly the run whose probability map you need to see: it says whether the network found nothing, or found plenty and the threshold threw it away.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.MakeMasksScreen.run_cellpose#1
records.source: The two panes are filled BEFORE the mask is touched, and they are filled even when the run found nothing at all. A run that returns an empty mask is exactly the run whose probability map you need to see: it says whether the network found nothing, or found plenty and the threshold threw it away.
records.translation: 两个面板被填充之前掩膜被触摸,并且它们被填补,即使运行根本没有找到任何东西. 返回一个空的掩膜的运行正是你需要看到的确率地图的走路:它说是否网络找不到任何东西,或者发现了很多,阈值扔掉它。

records.context: The image goes in as a **batch of one**, which is what :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.parse_cellpose4_output` — the repository's own reader of this return value — is written for. Handed a bare 2-D array instead, ``eval`` returns a flat three-member flows list and that function reads ``len(masks)`` as the number of images and finds the image height, so the parse fails on an image that segmented perfectly well.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.cellpose_detect#1
records.source: The image goes in as a **batch of one**, which is what :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.parse_cellpose4_output` — the repository's own reader of this return value — is written for. Handed a bare 2-D array instead, ``eval`` returns a flat three-member flows list and that function reads ``len(masks)`` as the number of images and finds the image height, so the parse fails on an image that segmented perfectly well.
records.translation: 图像进入为一个**的**对比,这是什么:func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.parse_cellpose4_output` - 该回报值的库本身的读者 - 是写的。 使用一个纯2D序列,而不是, ``eval``返回一个平板的三成员流列表,该函数阅读 ``len(masks)``作为图像的数量,并找到图像的高度,所以分裂失败在一个图像,分割完美好。

records.context: A greyscale probability map beside a greyscale image is two pictures that look alike and mean different things. A colour ramp says at a glance which pixels the network was confident about, which is the whole reason to look at this map before moving a threshold.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.cellprob_heatmap#1
records.source: A greyscale probability map beside a greyscale image is two pictures that look alike and mean different things. A colour ramp says at a glance which pixels the network was confident about, which is the whole reason to look at this map before moving a threshold.
records.translation: 灰色概率地图旁边的灰色图像是两张相似的图像,意思是不同的东西。 一个颜色拉姆说,在一眼中,哪个像素的网络是自信的,这是整个原因,看看这个地图之前移动一个阈值。

records.context: :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` is what the workflow itself calls: it maps every pre-SAM name onto ``cpsam``, keeps a fine-tuned checkpoint path as itself, and raises rather than quietly substituting stock weights for a checkpoint that is not there. Going around it with a second, simpler call would give this screen a different answer from the processing session it is meant to be correcting.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.make_masks.load_cellpose_model#1
records.source: :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` is what the pipeline itself calls: it maps every pre-SAM name onto ``cpsam``, keeps a fine-tuned checkpoint path as itself, and raises rather than quietly substituting stock weights for a checkpoint that is not there. Going around it with a second, simpler call would give this screen a different answer from the run it is meant to be correcting.
records.translation: :func:`spacr.utils._resolve_cellpose_pretrained` 就是工作流本身所称之为: 它将每个 pre-SAM 名称地图到 ``cpsam`` ,保持一个精致的检查点路径本身, 而不是安静地取代存储权重,而不是一个不存在的检查点。 用第二次,更简单的呼叫会给这个筛选一个不同的答案,从处理会议它是要修正的。

records.translation: 移植自独立的整理工具（``plaque_assay_model/tools/curate_masks_qt.py``），这些功能最初是针对结晶紫染色的蚀斑扫描图构建的。这种失败并非该染色特有：细胞核接触明亮的纤维，与蚀斑接触孔的边缘，是同一种泛洪沿同一种缝隙泄漏出去。

records.context: A pixel joins when its distance from the seed's value is at most ``tolerance`` -- absolute difference on a grey image, Euclidean distance across image data channels on a colour one -- and it is reachable from the seed through four-connected steps. Both rules are :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.magic_wand`'s, so the region this returns is the region that wand would fill given no pixel budget.

records.source: A pixel joins when its distance from the seed's value is at most ``tolerance`` -- absolute difference on a grey image, Euclidean distance across channels on a colour one -- and it is reachable from the seed through four-connected steps. Both rules are :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.magic_wand`'s, so the region this returns is the region that wand would fill given no pixel budget.
records.translation: 一个像素加入时,它的距离从种子的值是最多``tolerance`` - 绝对的差异在一个灰色图像,图像数据通道在一个颜色的Euklid的距离 - 它可以从种子通过四个连接的步骤到达。 两个规则是 :func:`spacr.qt.mask_engine.magic_wand` 的,所以这个回归的区域是该区域,如果没有 pixel 预算,它会充满。

records.context: 1. *The timer stops whenever the widget is not on application view* — hidden, on another tab, or in a minimised window. Zero frames, zero CPU. These application views stay open for hours, so this is the whole ball game. 2. *Diffuse themes are painted into a small reusable QImage and scaled up*. The buffer's long edge is whatever the theme declares (:attr:`_BufferedEngine.base_edge`) times the user's resolution setting, so diffuse fields shade ~37 000 pixels instead of ~2 000 000. The aurora and data-art materials preserve native display detail within the actual application view-pixel budget. Aurora returns an owned frame, avoiding a second full-size copy when a shading worker publishes it. 3. *The shading happens on its own independent execution path* (:class:`_FrameProducer`), so the main GUI execution path's whole share of a frame is one ``drawImage``. That is the next section, and it is the one that matters while a workflow is executing.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#16
records.source: 1. *The timer stops whenever the widget is not on screen* — hidden, on another tab, or in a minimised window. Zero frames, zero CPU. These screens stay open for hours, so this is the whole ball game. 2. *Diffuse themes are painted into a small reusable QImage and scaled up*. The buffer's long edge is whatever the theme declares (:attr:`_BufferedEngine.base_edge`) times the user's resolution setting, so diffuse fields shade ~37 000 pixels instead of ~2 000 000. The aurora and data-art materials preserve native display detail within the actual screen-pixel budget. Aurora returns an owned frame, avoiding a second full-size copy when a shading worker publishes it. 3. *The shading happens on its own thread* (:class:`_FrameProducer`), so the GUI thread's whole share of a frame is one ``drawImage``. That is the next section, and it is the one that matters while a pipeline is running.
records.translation: 1. *时间表停止,每当 widget 不在应用程序视图* - 隐藏,在另一个选项卡,或在一个最小化的窗口. 零框,零 CPU. 这些应用程序的视图保持开放几个小时,所以这是整个球游戏. 2. *分散主题被绘制到一个小可重复使用的 QImage 和扩展到*。 泡沫的长边是任何主题声明(:attr:`_BufferedEngine.base_edge`) 用户的分辨率设置,所以分散场的阴影 ~37 000 像素而不是 ~2 000 000. 该 aurora 和数据艺术材料保留本地显示细节在实际应用程序观点预算内。 *影子发生在自己的独立执行路径*(:class:`_FrameProducer`),所以主要的 GUI执行路的整个部分的框架是一个``drawImage``。

records.context: The one exception is a backdrop that stops while it is still on application view -- a CPU-heavy run pausing the animation (:func:`_animation_paused_for_work`), reduced motion, or the animation switched off. Its frame on application view is kept as the still (:meth:`_paint_still`), because every console line and figure the window paints over it asks it for a whole frame again, and shading that frame on the main GUI execution path against the processing session's worker took 250-350 ms on lesson 08's Measure run. Hidden, it keeps nothing.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AmbientWidget.stop#2
records.source: The one exception is a backdrop that stops while it is still on screen -- a CPU-heavy run pausing the animation (:func:`_animation_paused_for_work`), reduced motion, or the animation switched off. Its frame on screen is kept as the still (:meth:`_paint_still`), because every console line and figure the window paints over it asks it for a whole frame again, and shading that frame on the GUI thread against the run's worker took 250-350 ms on lesson 08's Measure run. Hidden, it keeps nothing.
records.translation: 其中一个例外是停留在应用程序视图时的背景 - CPU - 重运行停止动画(:func:`_animation_paused_for_work`),减少动作,或动画关闭. 应用程序观图上的框架保持为静态(:meth:`_paint_still`),因为每个控制台线和图像窗口画在它上要求它一个完整的框架再次,并在主要的 GUI执行路径上遮盖这个框架,处理会议的工作进程在课堂08的测量运行中花了250-350ms。

records.translation: 默认输入一个模型事件圈 测试注射一个运行器检查对话并返回 ``QDialog.Accepted``/``Rejected`` 没有任何阻止 - 这也是如何主机可以在不模型演示文稿后交换。

records.context: The reads leave the main GUI execution path deliberately: the summary stats every database and then opens each with sqlite, over paths that are the user's own -- one of them an autofs mount that had not answered a single stat after twenty seconds -- and doing that while a settings panel lays out froze the application. Two runners rather than one, because ``job_finished`` carries a bool and no job identity: a shared runner could not tell whose failure it was being told about, so the restore check failing would clear the summary read's in-flight flag and paint its error over a read still executing.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.database_set.DatabaseSetWidget#10
records.source: The reads leave the GUI thread deliberately: the summary stats every database and then opens each with sqlite, over paths that are the user's own -- one of them an autofs mount that had not answered a single stat after twenty seconds -- and doing that while a settings panel lays out froze the application. Two runners rather than one, because ``job_finished`` carries a bool and no job identity: a shared runner could not tell whose failure it was being told about, so the restore check failing would clear the summary read's in-flight flag and paint its error over a read still running.
records.translation: 读者故意离开主 GUI 执行路径:概述统计每个数据库,然后打开每一个与 sqlite,通过路径是用户的 - 其中一个没有回复一个单一状态后的二十秒 - 并这样做,而设置面板放出冻结应用程序. 两个运行器而不是一个,因为 ``job_finished`` 携带一个泡沫和没有工作身份:一个共享运行器不能告诉谁的失败它被告知,所以恢复检查失败将清理概述的阅读在飞行旗帜,并绘制其错误在一个阅读仍然执行。

records.context: Qt aborts the process when an executing QThread is destroyed, and this widget starts them. Public because it is a child -- a settings panel builds it inside a form, and Qt delivers a close event to the window rather than to every widget in it, so a host that wants the reads stopped when the user navigates away has to say so.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.database_set.DatabaseSetWidget.shutdown#1
records.source: Qt aborts the process when a running QThread is destroyed, and this widget starts them. Public because it is a child -- a settings panel builds it inside a form, and Qt delivers a close event to the window rather than to every widget in it, so a host that wants the reads stopped when the user navigates away has to say so.
records.translation: Qt 堕胎过程,当一个执行 QThread 被摧毁,这个 widget 开始它们. 公共,因为它是一个孩子 - 设置面板构建它在一个表格,而 Qt 提供一个接近的事件到窗口而不是每个 widget 在它,所以一个宿主谁想要阅读停止,当用户浏览时必须这样说。

records.context: Not the only line of defence: the QThreads are unparented and retire themselves, and ``JobRunner._relay`` catches the ``RuntimeError`` PySide6 raises when a worker settles after its runner's C++ half has gone.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.database_set.DatabaseSetWidget.shutdown#2
records.source: Not the only line of defence: the QThreads are unparented and retire themselves, and ``JobRunner._relay`` catches the ``RuntimeError`` PySide6 raises when a worker settles after its runner's C++ half has gone.
records.translation: 不是唯一的防御线: QThreads 是无家可归的,退休自己, ``JobRunner._relay`` 抓住 ``RuntimeError`` PySide6 升起,当一个工作进程在他的运行器的 C++ 半已经消失后安排。

records.context: Random colour is *per column*, and a column is one falling string among a hundred. Rolling all three HSL components would have given the field a scatter of near-blacks, near-whites and greys — most of which do not read as glyphs at 20 % opacity behind a settings form. Only the hue is random; saturation and lightness are taken from the colour in the picker, floored and clamped so the result is always a colour and always visible.

Only the hue is random; saturation and lightness are taken from the colour in the picker, floored and clamped so the result is always a colour and always visible.
records.translation: 随机颜色为 *每列*,而一个列是百分之百中的一条落行。 滚动所有三个 HSL 组件将给该场一个接近黑色,接近白色和灰色的分布 - 其中大多数不像格里夫在设置形式背后的 20% 不透明度。 只有是偶然的。 饱和和轻度从皮克的颜色中取出,鲜花和粘贴,因此结果总是颜色,总是可见。

records.context: The parameterisation has an exact symmetry: ``(bottom, top, L, h)`` and ``(top, bottom, L, -h)`` are the *same function*, so the optimiser may return either. Left alone, two runs on the same data can report Hill slopes of opposite sign. Every fit is therefore canonicalised the way pharmacology already writes it (and GraphPad's variable-slope equations do):
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response#11

records.translation: 参数化有一个准确的对称: ``(bottom, top, L, h)`` 和 ``(top, bottom, L, -h)`` 是 *相同的函数*,所以优化器也可以回来。 单独在相同数据上,两次运行可以报告 Hill 的反向信号。

records.context: Host toxicity over parasite killing, with its confidence interval.

records.translation: 宿主毒性对寄生虫杀戮,其信任间隔。

records.context: For an anti-parasitic compound this ratio, not the EC50, shows whether the compound is selective. A compound that kills the parasite at 1 uM and the host monolayer at 1.2 uM is not a hit, and an EC50 quoted with a clean confidence interval does not show that.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.SelectivityIndex#1
records.source: For an anti-parasitic compound this ratio, not the EC50, shows whether the compound is selective. A compound that kills the parasite at 1 uM and the host monolayer at 1.2 uM is not a hit, and an EC50 quoted with a clean confidence interval does not show that.
records.translation: 对于抗寄生虫的化合物,这个比例,而不是EC50,是否是选择性的。 杀死寄生虫在1 uM和主机单元在1.2 uM的化学物质不是一个打击,并且引用的EC50与纯粹的信任间隔不显示这一点。

records.context: the host-viability fit.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.SelectivityIndex#8
records.source: the host-viability fit.
records.translation: 宿主可行性合适。

records.context: A laboratory microplate without an assay window is refused rather than scaled by noise. When a laboratory microplate's two controls do not separate there is no assay window, and dividing by that near-zero difference would turn well-to-well noise into hundreds of percent inhibition and a confident EC50 on a laboratory microplate that measured nothing. Such a laboratory microplate's rows come back with a NaN response and a :class:`PlateReport` saying so.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.normalise_to_controls#4
records.source: A plate without an assay window is refused rather than scaled by noise. When a plate's two controls do not separate there is no assay window, and dividing by that near-zero difference would turn well-to-well noise into hundreds of percent inhibition and a confident EC50 on a plate that measured nothing. Such a plate's rows come back with a NaN response and a :class:`PlateReport` saying so.
records.translation: 没有测量窗口的实验室微板被拒绝,而不是由噪音扩展。 当一个实验室微板的两个控制器不分开时,没有测试窗口,并且通过这个近零差异分裂会将孔间噪音转化为百分之百的抑制和一个可靠的EC50在实验室小板上测量什么都没有。 这样的实验室微板的行回来,有 NaN 反应和 :class:`PlateReport` 这样说。

records.context: laboratory microplate label to that laboratory microplate's fit. Only fits that are :data:`STATUS_FITTED` with a closed interval can carry a weight; the rest are counted, named in the note and left out of the arithmetic, because a laboratory microplate whose EC50 is unbounded has no variance to weight by and dropping it silently would make the pooled interval look better than the experiment was.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.pool_across_plates#2
records.source: plate label to that plate's fit. Only fits that are :data:`STATUS_FITTED` with a closed interval can carry a weight; the rest are counted, named in the note and left out of the arithmetic, because a plate whose EC50 is unbounded has no variance to weight by and dropping it silently would make the pooled interval look better than the experiment was.
records.translation: 实验室微板标签到该实验室小板的合适。 :data:`STATUS_FITTED` 有一个关闭的间隔可以携带权重;其余的被计算,在笔记中命名,并留在算法上,因为一个实验室的微板 EC50 是无限的没有变量到权重,并沉默地放下它会使平衡间隔看起来比实验更好。

records.context: The two fits come from one plate. spaCR segments host cell and pathogen as separate object types from the same image, so host viability and parasite burden are measured at the same doses in the same run, whereas most selectivity indices divide two numbers from two experiments whose conditions may differ.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.selectivity_index#1
records.source: The two fits come from one plate. spaCR segments host cell and pathogen as separate object types from the same image, so host viability and parasite burden are measured at the same doses in the same run, whereas most selectivity indices divide two numbers from two experiments whose conditions may differ.
records.translation: spaCR分区宿主细胞和病原体作为单一图像的单独对象类型,因此主体可行性和寄生虫负担在同一行程中以相同的剂量进行测量,而大多数选择性指数分为两个数字,从两个实验中,其条件可能有所不同。

records.context: The design: "id like the user to have access to visualizing adjusted P in all the ways that are acceptable to the field. showing as color, showing the descrete P on the axis buy showing the line where the adjusted p threshold lands, etc."

records.source: The design: "id like the user to have access to visualizing adjusted P in all the ways that are acceptable to the field. showing as color, showing the descrete P on the axis buy showing the line where the adjusted p threshold lands, etc."
records.translation: 设计: “像用户有访问可调整的P在所有方式是可接受的字段,显示为颜色,显示的描述P在轴购买显示的线路,在那里调整的p阈值土地,等等。

records.context: Placed beside the correction and above the restyling, because these change what the picture means -- which channel carries the FDR -- and not about how it looks. Two of them compete for the colour channel and one composes with whatever is on it; the entries say so and the caption says which is in force.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.FastPlot.offer_encodings#3
records.source: Placed beside the correction and above the restyling, because these change what the picture means -- which channel carries the FDR -- and not about how it looks. Two of them compete for the colour channel and one composes with whatever is on it; the entries say so and the caption says which is in force.
records.translation: 放置在纠正和复制之上,因为这些改变了图像意味着什么 - 哪个通道携带FDR - 而不是它是什么样子。

records.context: Offered by the host rather than built in, and for the same reason :meth:`offer_refit` is: only the plot that owns the arrays knows whether its x-axis is a set of groups at all. A volcano's x is an effect size, and "show it as a violin" is not a question that has an answer there.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.FastPlot.offer_marks#2
records.source: Offered by the host rather than built in, and for the same reason :meth:`offer_refit` is: only the plot that owns the arrays knows whether its x-axis is a set of groups at all. A volcano's x is an effect size, and "show it as a violin" is not a question that has an answer there.
records.translation: 由宿主提供,而不是建在其中,而且同样的原因 :meth:`offer_refit` 是:只有拥有草坪的草坪知道它的 x 轴是否是一个组合,火山的 x 是效果大小,而“显示它像紫色”不是一个问题,有答案。

records.context: ``None`` for an empty plot is the other half. A tile showing an empty plot invites a click that opens an empty plot, and a run that has fitted nothing yet should have no tile at all rather than a misleading one.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.FastPlot.snapshot#6
records.source: ``None`` for an empty plot is the other half. A tile showing an empty plot invites a click that opens an empty plot, and a run that has fitted nothing yet should have no tile at all rather than a misleading one.
records.translation: ``None`` 对于一个空的插件,则是另一半。 显示一个空虚的字符串的绳子邀请一个点击打开一个空白的文字符串,而一个没有配备任何东西的运行应该没有任何字符,而不是一个误导一个。

records.context: Benjamini-Hochberg's adjusted P is a cumulative minimum taken from the largest P downwards -- ``q_(i) = min over j >= i of (n * p_(j) / j)`` -- and the ``min`` is both what enforces monotonicity and what creates ties: the moment a later rank produces a smaller value, every earlier rank is pulled down onto it. Measured on reference runs: 823 q values with 31 distinct, 19 tied levels covering 811 coefficients, GRA14 and 225160 both at 4.1150e-03. A volcano drawn against that has a staircase for a y-axis, and no transform can separate two tests that hold the same number.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.VolcanoPlot#2
records.source: Benjamini-Hochberg's adjusted P is a cumulative minimum taken from the largest P downwards -- ``q_(i) = min over j >= i of (n * p_(j) / j)`` -- and the ``min`` is both what enforces monotonicity and what creates ties: the moment a later rank produces a smaller value, every earlier rank is pulled down onto it. Measured on reference runs: 823 q values with 31 distinct, 19 tied levels covering 811 coefficients, GRA14 and 225160 both at 4.1150e-03. A volcano drawn against that has a staircase for a y-axis, and no transform can separate two tests that hold the same number.
records.translation: Benjamini-Hochberg 调整的 P 是从最大的 P 向下采取的累积最低 - ``q_(i) = min over j >= i of (n * p_(j) / j)`` - 和 ``min`` 既是强制单调性,又是创造联系:瞬间后排产生较小的值,每个之前排被拖到它上。 测量在参考运行: 823 q 值有 31 分, 19 连接水平覆盖 811 比例, GRA14 和 225160 两在 4.1150e-03. 对此拖动的火山有一个步骤为 y 轴,没有转换可以分开两个测试保持相同的数字。

records.context: So the height is the raw P, which is continuous and is the evidence per test, and the correction decides the colour and the threshold line, which are discrete. Nothing is invented, which is also why this plot does not jitter the y axis to separate ties: that would move a point away from its own value.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.VolcanoPlot#3
records.source: So the height is the raw P, which is continuous and is the evidence per test, and the correction decides the colour and the threshold line, which are discrete. Nothing is invented, which is also why this plot does not jitter the y axis to separate ties: that would move a point away from its own value.
records.translation: 因此,高度是原始的P,它是连续的,是每试验的证据,纠正决定颜色和阈值线,这些是差异的。

records.context: Which of :data:`Q_COLOURS` has the colour channel.

records.context: Lifted out of `spacr.qt.screens.settings_model`, where it was written for the settings panel's chip strip, because a wrapping row is not a settings idea: the regression results header wants one too. Three combo boxes with minimum widths, a processing session name of unpredictable length and a QHBoxLayout do not fit in a narrow panel, and Qt's answer to a box it cannot satisfy is to let the children overlap -- measured at 577 px, where the second box started 48 px inside the first and the third ran 32 px off the panel.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.flow#1
records.source: Lifted out of `spacr.qt.screens.settings_model`, where it was written for the settings panel's chip strip, because a wrapping row is not a settings idea: the regression results header wants one too. Three combo boxes with minimum widths, a run name of unpredictable length and a QHBoxLayout do not fit in a narrow panel, and Qt's answer to a box it cannot satisfy is to let the children overlap -- measured at 577 px, where the second box started 48 px inside the first and the third ran 32 px off the panel.
records.translation: 从 `spacr.qt.screens.settings_model` 升起,在那里它是为设定面板的芯片带写的,因为一条曲线不是设定的想法:回归结果的头部也想要一个。 三个组合盒子,最小的宽度,一个处理会议名称的意想不到的长度和一个 QHBoxLayout 不适合在一个狭窄的面板,而 Qt 对一个盒子的答案,它不能满足是让孩子们超越 - 测量为 577 px,其中第二个盒子开始 48 px 在第一个和第三个运行 32 px 从面板。

records.context: A checkable fold controls a workflow implemented by settings on its host. Timelapse settings are mounted on Mask Generation because tracking extends the segmentation run; its button reveals those categories and enables the corresponding workflow stage. Motility Assay instead opens from Measure and analyzes existing masks. A checkable button remains active while its workflow is enabled, and its callback receives the new state.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip#5
records.source: A checkable fold controls a workflow implemented by settings on its host. Timelapse settings are mounted on Mask Generation because tracking extends the segmentation run; its button reveals those categories and enables the corresponding pipeline stage. Motility Assay instead opens from Measure and analyzes existing masks. A checkable button remains active while its workflow is enabled, and its callback receives the new state.
records.translation: 可验证的字符串控制了由其主机上的设置实施的工作流程。 按摩设置安装在掩膜代,因为跟踪延长分割运行; 按钮揭示了这些类别,并允许相应的工作流段。 动态评估 相反,从测量中打开并分析现有掩膜。

records.context: whether the button is a SWITCH rather than a press. True for a fold whose workflow is implemented by settings on the host module -- Timelapse rides on Mask Generation, because tracking extends the segmentation run -- so the button stays active while that workflow is enabled and its callback receives the new state. False, the default, is a plain click that opens a module.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.FoldButton#3
records.source: whether the button is a SWITCH rather than a press. True for a fold whose workflow is implemented by settings on the host module -- Timelapse rides on Mask Generation, because tracking extends the segmentation run -- so the button stays active while that workflow is enabled and its callback receives the new state. False, the default, is a plain click that opens a module.
records.translation: 是否按钮是一个SWITCH而不是一个打印。 True 为一个工作流由主机模块的设置实施的字符串 -- Timelapse在掩膜一代上骑行, 因为跟踪延长分割运行 -- 因此,按钮保持活跃,而该工作流被启用,其呼叫回收新的状态。 False,默认情况下,是一个平板点击,打开一个模块。

records.context: For a caller that has a structured-data name and needs its name, description and stage, whether or not the structured-data name's host is one :func:`folded_modules` walks. Hosts named only in :data:`spacr.qt.app._EXTRA_FOLD_HOSTS` -- Graph Builder, QC Dashboard and Database Browser -- are not walked there, so without this the dock rows of the modules folded onto them would show the raw structured-data name, such as `lineage`, `tabulate` or `control_chart`.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.fold_label#1
records.source: For a caller that has a key and needs its name, description and stage, whether or not the key's host is one :func:`folded_modules` walks. Hosts named only in :data:`spacr.qt.app._EXTRA_FOLD_HOSTS` -- Graph Builder, QC Dashboard and Database Browser -- are not walked there, so without this the dock rows of the modules folded onto them would show the raw key, such as `lineage`, `tabulate` or `control_chart`.
records.translation: 对于具有结构化数据名称并需要其名称、描述和阶段的呼叫者,无论结构化信息名称的宿主还是不,都是一个 :func:`folded_modules` 路径。 仅在 :data:`spacr.qt.app._EXTRA_FOLD_HOSTS` - Graph Builder、 QC 磁盘和 Database Browser 中命名的宿主 - 都没有路径,因此,没有此,模块的附带行将显示原始结构化的数据名,如 `lineage`、`tabulate` 或 `control_chart`。

records.context: The host is determined by the button list it actually draws, not by the location of fallback text. The latter may be shared: Map Barcodes keeps descriptions for folds owned by Image UMAP, Regression, Mask, and other screens. Treating that shared catalog as membership sends documentation and tutorial links to the wrong screen.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.folded_modules#1
records.source: The host is determined by the button list it actually draws, not by the location of fallback text. The latter may be shared: Map Barcodes keeps descriptions for folds owned by Image UMAP, Regression, Mask, and other screens. Treating that shared catalog as membership sends documentation and tutorial links to the wrong screen.
records.translation: 宿主是由按钮列表它实际上提取,而不是由落后文本的位置。 后者可以共享: Map Barcodes 保留由 Image UMAP, Regression, Mask, 和其他筛选所拥有的文件夹的描述。

records.context: A host's own fallback record is preferred. If it does not keep one, the other host tables are searched in declaration order. The first host to list a duplicated structured-data name still wins, making an accidental double fold deterministic until its invariant test reports the duplication.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.folded_modules#2
records.source: A host's own fallback record is preferred. If it does not keep one, the other host tables are searched in declaration order. The first host to list a duplicated key still wins, making an accidental double fold deterministic until its invariant test reports the duplication.
records.translation: 宿主自己的落后记录是优先的. 如果它不保留一个,其余的宿主表在声明顺序中搜索. 列出重复的结构化数据名称的第一个主办人仍然赢得,使一个随机的双字定义,直到其不变的测试报告重复。

records.context: The registry part is complete only after registration. Several rows arrive from :func:`spacr.qt.register_self_registering_modules`, so a caller that asks before registration gets the folds whose hosts kept a record and not the ones whose rows have not been added yet. Every caller inside the application asks after the window is built; a test that asks earlier has to register first, and one that does not is testing the order it happened to import in.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.folded_modules#5
records.source: The registry part is complete only after registration. Several rows arrive from :func:`spacr.qt.register_self_registering_modules`, so a caller that asks before registration gets the folds whose hosts kept a record and not the ones whose rows have not been added yet. Every caller inside the application asks after the window is built; a test that asks earlier has to register first, and one that does not is testing the order it happened to import in.
records.translation: 登记部分仅在登记后完成。 多个行从 :func:`spacr.qt.register_self_registering_modules` 到来,因此在登录之前请求的召唤者将获得其宿主保留记录的文件夹,而不是尚未添加的文件列。

records.context: Arithmetic gives ``float64``; a comparison or an ``and``/``or``/``not`` gives ``bool``. The bool case is on purpose: a boolean column lands in :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` as a *category*, so ``infected = pathogen_count > 0`` immediately becomes a tick box in the filter panel and a colour channel in the Graph Builder.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula#15
records.source: Arithmetic gives ``float64``; a comparison or an ``and``/``or``/``not`` gives ``bool``. The bool case is on purpose: a boolean column lands in :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` as a *category*, so ``infected = pathogen_count > 0`` immediately becomes a tick box in the filter panel and a colour channel in the Graph Builder.
records.translation: Arithmetic 提供 ``float64``; 比较或 ``and``/``or`` / ``not`` 提供了 ``bool``. 泡沫案例是目的:一个泡沫列落在 :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` 作为一个 *类别*,因此 ``infected = pathogen_count > 0`` 立即成为过滤器板中的点箱和 Graph Builder中的颜色通道。

records.context: Nowhere, by itself. The panel emits :attr:`FormulaPanel.formulas_changed` and the host re-hands the computed frame to whatever it is driving — the trellis, the data-selection boundary editor, the feature explorer, the Local Data Filter. No other integration is needed: a computed column is an ordinary column from the moment it exists, classified by the same :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` rule as a measured one, so it appears in the column well, in the filter picker and in the export without any of them being told about formulas.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula_editor#7
records.source: Nowhere, by itself. The panel emits :attr:`FormulaPanel.formulas_changed` and the host re-hands the computed frame to whatever it is driving — the trellis, the gate editor, the feature explorer, the Local Data Filter. No other integration is needed: a computed column is an ordinary column from the moment it exists, classified by the same :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` rule as a measured one, so it appears in the column well, in the filter picker and in the export without any of them being told about formulas.
records.translation: 面板发出 :attr:`FormulaPanel.formulas_changed` 并且主机将计算框重新掌握到它正在运行的任何地方 - 拖拉机,数据选择边界编辑器,特征探测器,本地数据过滤器. 没有其他集成是必要的:计算列是从它存在的那一刻起的常规列,由相同的 :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` 规则分类为一个测量列,所以它出现在列中好,在过滤图和出口中,没有其中任何人被告知的公式。

records.context: an existing :class:`FormulaPanel` to host. ``None`` builds one, which is the ordinary case; passing one lets a screen keep the panel alive across openings so a half-written formula survives.

records.context: A frame that arrives very late -- the machine slept, or a run took the CPU -- is treated as a short one, because a single huge step would put the camera at the target instantly and look like a cut.

records.context: Fit :class:`sklearn.covariance.MinCovDet` — the Minimum Covariance Determinant — to the selected features, take each object's squared Mahalanobis distance to the robust centre in the robust metric, and flag it against a chi-square quantile.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#17
records.source: Fit :class:`sklearn.covariance.MinCovDet` — the Minimum Covariance Determinant — to the selected features, take each object's squared Mahalanobis distance to the robust centre in the robust metric, and flag it against a chi-square quantile.
records.translation: 符合 :class:`sklearn.covariance.MinCovDet` - 最低可调定性 - 到所选择的特征,将每个对象的平方 Mahalanobis 距离到坚固的中心在强度测量中,并将其与一个 Chi-square 量子相反。

records.context: **The threshold is a stated false-positive rate, not a tuned fraction.** Under multivariate normality the squared robust Mahalanobis distance is distributed chi-square with ``p`` degrees of freedom, so the cut point is ``chi2.ppf(1 - alpha, p)`` for a chosen ``alpha`` — default :data:`DEFAULT_ALPHA` = 0.001, meaning *one clean object in a thousand is expected to be flagged*. Over 10^5 objects that is about 100 false flags, and over the 200,000 objects of a typical two-plate screen it is about 200. That number is knowable in advance and is printed in :meth:`OutlierResult.caveats`. An isolation forest's score has no such null distribution and therefore no calibrated cut point at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#19
records.source: **The threshold is a stated false-positive rate, not a tuned fraction.** Under multivariate normality the squared robust Mahalanobis distance is distributed chi-square with ``p`` degrees of freedom, so the cut point is ``chi2.ppf(1 - alpha, p)`` for a chosen ``alpha`` — default :data:`DEFAULT_ALPHA` = 0.001, meaning *one clean object in a thousand is expected to be flagged*. Over 10^5 objects that is about 100 false flags, and over the 200,000 objects of a typical two-plate screen it is about 200. That number is knowable in advance and is printed in :meth:`OutlierResult.caveats`. An isolation forest's score has no such null distribution and therefore no calibrated cut point at all.
records.translation: **阈值是指定的虚假积极率,而不是折叠分数.** 在多变的正常性下,平面坚固的Mahalanobis距离分配为``p``度自由的Chi-Square。, 因此,切割点为 ``chi2.ppf(1 - alpha, p)`` 为 ``alpha`` 选择 — 默认 :data:`DEFAULT_ALPHA` = 0.001, 意思是 *一个清洁的对象在一千 预计将被标记*. 超过 10^5 对象约为 100 个虚假的旗帜, 在典型的两板筛选的200000个对象中,它大约是200个,这个数字是预先可知的,并以:meth:`OutlierResult.caveats`打印的。

records.context: **The cost, stated.** MCD needs ``n > p`` to have a covariance at all, and it is unstable until roughly ``n >= 2p`` (:data:`MCD_MIN_OBJECTS_PER_FEATURE` * p): the estimate is fitted on a *subset* of about ``n/2`` rows, so ``n = 2p`` already means the subset is only barely larger than the dimension. Its breakdown point is set by ``support_fraction``: the sklearn default of ``(n + p + 1) / 2n`` gives the maximum ~50%, and raising it trades robustness for efficiency. Too few objects for the number of features is **refused with a message that names the way out**: run a PCA first (:func:`spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.pca`) and flag on the first few components, which are fewer, uncorrelated, and carry the same information.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#24
records.source: **The cost, stated.** MCD needs ``n > p`` to have a covariance at all, and it is unstable until roughly ``n >= 2p`` (:data:`MCD_MIN_OBJECTS_PER_FEATURE` * p): the estimate is fitted on a *subset* of about ``n/2`` rows, so ``n = 2p`` already means the subset is only barely larger than the dimension. Its breakdown point is set by ``support_fraction``: the sklearn default of ``(n + p + 1) / 2n`` gives the maximum ~50%, and raising it trades robustness for efficiency. Too few objects for the number of features is **refused with a message that names the way out**: run a PCA first (:func:`spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.pca`) and flag on the first few components, which are fewer, uncorrelated, and carry the same information.
records.translation: **成本,表示.** MCD 需要 ``n > p`` 以便在任何情况下都有可见性, 它是不稳定的,直到大约``n >= 2p``(:data:`MCD_MIN_OBJECTS_PER_FEATURE` * p): 估计为 *subset* 约 ``n/2`` 行, 因此 ``n = 2p`` 已经意味着子组几乎不大于尺寸,其分裂点由 ``support_fraction`` 设置。: ``(n + p + 1) / 2n`` 的 sklearn 默认值为最大 ~50%, 太少的对象为特征的数量是 **被拒绝的一个消息,命名出路**: 运行一个 PCA 第一 (:func:`spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.pca`) 和旗帜在第一几个组件, 更少的,不相关的。, 并携带相同的信息。

records.context: The well pass reduces each well to a robust summary — the **median** of each feature over the well's objects, plus ``n`` — and then runs *the same* rule (:data:`METHOD_MAD`, :data:`METHOD_IQR` or :data:`METHOD_MAHALANOBIS`) across microplate sample positions. The median rather than the mean for the same reason as everywhere else here: a single blown-up object must not become a bad well.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#30
records.source: The well pass reduces each well to a robust summary — the **median** of each feature over the well's objects, plus ``n`` — and then runs *the same* rule (:data:`METHOD_MAD`, :data:`METHOD_IQR` or :data:`METHOD_MAHALANOBIS`) across wells. The median rather than the mean for the same reason as everywhere else here: a single blown-up object must not become a bad well.
records.translation: 通道将每个通道缩小到一个坚实的总结 - 每个函数的**median**在通道对象上,加上``n`` - 然后在微板样本位置上运行*相同的*规则(:data:`METHOD_MAD`,:data:`METHOD_IQR`或:data:`METHOD_MAHALANOBIS`)。 中间而不是中间,因为同样的原因,如同在其他地方:一个单一的爆炸对象不应该变成一个坏的孔。

records.context: **A well is not scored on three objects.** Below :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_WELL_OBJECTS` objects the median is too noisy for a comparison across microplate sample positions to mean anything, so the well appears in the well frame with ``well_scored = False`` and a reason saying how many objects it had. It is **never silently dropped and never quietly scored** — a low-n well excluded without a word is how an empty well becomes an unremarkable row.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model#31
records.source: **A well is not scored on three objects.** Below :data:`DEFAULT_MIN_WELL_OBJECTS` objects the median is too noisy for a comparison across wells to mean anything, so the well appears in the well frame with ``well_scored = False`` and a reason saying how many objects it had. It is **never silently dropped and never quietly scored** — a low-n well excluded without a word is how an empty well becomes an unremarkable row.
records.translation: **A 不在三个对象中得分** 下面:data:`DEFAULT_MIN_WELL_OBJECTS`对象的中间对比太噪音,以便在微板样本位置上进行比较,所以在``well_scored = False``的良好框中出现,并且有一个理由说它有多少对象。 它是 **从未沉默地倒下,从未安静地得分** - 一个低n 被排除在没有一个词是如何一个空的孔变成一个不可注意的序列。

records.context: Raised rather than returned as an empty result. Every one of these is a sentence the user can act on — "``cell_area`` has 412 non-positive values and log10 of them is not a number", "3 features and 4 complete objects is fewer than the 6 the MCD needs" — and a caller that swallowed it would show an empty table with nothing to explain it. Application views catch it and print the message.

records.source: Raised rather than returned as an empty result. Every one of these is a sentence the user can act on — "``cell_area`` has 412 non-positive values and log10 of them is not a number", "3 features and 4 complete objects is fewer than the 6 the MCD needs" — and a caller that swallowed it would show an empty table with nothing to explain it. Screens catch it and print the message.
records.translation: 提取而不是返回作为一个空的结果. 其中每一个是用户可以采取行动的句子 — “``cell_area``有412非积极的值,并记录10其中不是一个数字”, “3个特征和4个完整的对象是少于MCD需要的6” — 和一个呼叫者吞下它会显示一个空白的表,没有什么可以解释它。

records.context: run the across-well pass. ``False`` for measurements that did not come off a laboratory microplate — and the only thing that makes a table with no well columns analysable at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model.OutlierSpec#10
records.source: run the across-well pass. ``False`` for measurements that did not come off a plate — and the only thing that makes a table with no well columns analysable at all.

records.source: on an unknown method or transform, a non-positive threshold, an alpha outside ``(0, 1)`` or a support fraction outside ``(0, 1]`` — at the point the spec is built, not half way through a 200,000-row fit.
records.translation: 以未知的方法或转换,非积极的阈值,外部``(0, 1)``的阿尔法或外部 ``(0, 1]``的支持分裂 - 在特征建造的地方,而不是半途通过200,000罗合并。

records.context: De-duplicate the features and well keys, and validate the detector.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model.OutlierSpec.__post_init__#0

records.context: Continuous by :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.column_kinds`, exactly as :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.candidate_features` picks its features — the one column machine-learning classification model in this codebase, re-read rather than re-derived, so PCA and this application view cannot disagree about what ``cell_count`` is.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model.candidate_features#1
records.source: Continuous by :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.column_kinds`, exactly as :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.candidate_features` picks its features — the one column classifier in this codebase, re-read rather than re-derived, so PCA and this screen cannot disagree about what ``cell_count`` is.
records.translation: 由 :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_spec.column_kinds` 连续,正如 :func:`spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model.candidate_features` 优化其特征 - 在此代码库中的单列机器学习分类模型,再阅读而不是再衍生,因此 PCA 和此应用程序视图不能不同意 ``cell_count`` 是什么。

records.context: The policy is in the module docstring; the short version is that nothing is estimated from a mean or an SD, that a zero MAD falls back to a stated alternative rather than dividing by zero, that a log transform is never applied unless asked for, that the multivariate test is an MCD Mahalanobis distance cut at a chi-square quantile so its threshold is a stated false-positive rate, and that **no row is ever dropped or altered** — the result adds columns.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model.detect_outliers#1
records.source: The policy is in the module docstring; the short version is that nothing is estimated from a mean or an SD, that a zero MAD falls back to a stated alternative rather than dividing by zero, that a log transform is never applied unless asked for, that the multivariate test is an MCD Mahalanobis distance cut at a chi-square quantile so its threshold is a stated false-positive rate, and that **no row is ever dropped or altered** — the result adds columns.
records.translation: 政策在模块文档中;简短的版本是,从中间或SD中没有任何估计,即零。 MAD 返回一个所述的替代品,而不是分为零,一个日志转换从未应用,除非要求,多变量测试是MCD Mahalanobis的距离切割在一个 Chi-square 量子,因此它的阈值是所述假积极的速度,并且 **没有序列会被切断或改变。** 结果添加列。

records.context: The microplate sample position pass reduces each microplate sample position to the median of each feature and runs the same rule across microplate sample positions, because a microplate sample position shifted as a whole flags almost none of its individual objects and is nevertheless unmistakable as a point among microplate sample positions.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.outlier_model.detect_outliers#2
records.source: The well pass reduces each well to the median of each feature and runs the same rule across wells, because a well shifted as a whole flags almost none of its individual objects and is nevertheless unmistakable as a point among wells.
records.translation: 微板样本位置通道将每个微板模板位置缩小到每个特征的中间,并在微板示板位置上运行相同的规则,因为一个微板的样品位置作为一个整体的旗帜几乎没有其个人对象,但它仍然不可错过,作为微板表面位置的一个点。

records.context: It is not free, and the cost is stated rather than hidden: equal weight means forty near-duplicate Zernike moments outvote one carefully chosen intensity ratio, and a feature that is pure noise gets the same unit of variance as a feature that is pure signal. :data:`SCALE_NONE` is there for the case where the user has already put the features in a common unit and *wants* the big ones to dominate.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#7
records.source: It is not free, and the cost is stated rather than hidden: equal weight means forty near-duplicate Zernike moments outvote one carefully chosen intensity ratio, and a feature that is pure noise gets the same unit of variance as a feature that is pure signal. :data:`SCALE_NONE` is there for the case where the user has already put the features in a common unit and *wants* the big ones to dominate.
records.translation: 它不是免费的,而成本是说而不是隐藏的:平重意味着四十近倍的Zernike时刻发出一个仔细选择的强度比例,而一个是纯噪音的特征得到相同的变量单位作为一个纯信号的特征。 :data:`SCALE_NONE` 是存在的,如果用户已经将特征放在一个共同的单位,并且 *希望* 大人要统治。

records.context: **Infinities are missing under every policy.** Ratio features produce ±inf from a zero denominator, an inf survives ``dropna``, and one of them destroys the scaling and therefore every component. They become NaN before the policy runs and are counted separately in :attr:`PCAResult.n_infinite`.

records.translation: **Infinities在每个政策下都缺少** 比例特征产生 ±inf 从零名称,一个 inf 生存 ``dropna``,其中一个破坏了扩展,因此每个组件。 它们在政策运行前变成 NaN 并在 :attr:`PCAResult.n_infinite` 中单独计算。

records.context: **Perfectly collinear** columns are a different problem and get a different answer: they are *kept*, because the feature list is the user's statement of what they care about and picking which of ``area`` and ``area_um2`` to discard is not this module's call. What is refused is inventing components out of the redundancy. The numerical rank is computed from the singular values and no more than ``rank`` components are ever returned, so a table of 12 features spanning 9 real directions yields 9 components, not 12 — the last three would have ~0 explained variance and a direction chosen by floating-point noise. Groups of features that are perfectly correlated are also detected and reported, since a duplicated feature silently doubles its own weight in a correlation PCA.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.pca_model#21

records.context: The most common way a PCA of morphology features misleads is that **PC1 is just size**. When every feature loads with the same sign, PC1 is a general-magnitude axis — big objects at one end, small at the other — which is usually a fact about segmentation rather than biology. :meth:`PCAResult.is_size_like` detects it from the loading signs and :meth:`PCAResult.headline` says it in words, unprompted.

records.translation: 最常见的方式,一个 PCA 的 morphology 特征错误是, **PC1 只是尺寸**。 当每个特征都充电同样的标志时,PC1是一个一般大小轴 - 一端的大物体,另一端小物体 - 通常是关于分裂而不是生物学的事实。 :meth:`PCAResult.is_size_like`从负载标志中检测到它,而:meth:`PCAResult.headline`则用单词说出它。

records.context: Near-collinear features leave a numerically full-rank matrix whose last directions are floating-point residue: the solver returns *a* direction because it must, not because the data has one. records.translation: 接近聚合物的特征留下一个数字化完整的矩阵,其最后方向是浮点残留物:溶剂返回 *a* 方向,因为它必须,而不是因为数据有一个。 :data:`DEGENERATE_RATIO` 总变量是与所说的报道,所以没有人从旋转错误中读取负载模式。

records.context: Every feature loading with the same sign is the classic "size" factor of morphometrics: one end big objects, the other end small ones. records.translation: 每个用同样的标志充电的特征都是古典的 "size" 形数学因素:一端大物体,另一端小物体. 它是真实的,它通常是PC1 ,它通常是一个关于分裂和焦点的声明而不是关于生物学 - 所以它被检测到并说出大声而不是留给读者注意。

records.context: Two guards prevent false detections. It needs three features, because with two "same sign" is a coin flip. And it needs the loading spread over more than one of them: a component that is a *single* feature trivially agrees with itself about sign, and calling that a size axis would be a statement about arithmetic rather than about the objects.

records.context: The sample is **random but reproducible**: the seed is a stable digest of ``"<folder name>|<total sets>|<cap>|<nonce>"`` (:func:`sample_seed`), so the same laboratory microplate at the same cap yields the same sets in this session, the next session, and on another machine or mount point — a preview can be described and returned to. It is deliberately *not* seeded from the clock or from ``hash()``, which is salted per process. Re-rendering never re-draws; only an explicit act does — changing the cap (which is in the seed) or calling :func:`~ImageSetSampler.reshuffle` (which bumps the nonce).

records.context: ``distinct_values`` runs one ``SELECT DISTINCT … LIMIT 501`` per ``(database, table)`` pair the chosen column appears in — and the columns a user actually excludes on (``plateID``, ``columnID``, ``rowID``) hold a handful of distinct values across the whole table, so the LIMIT is never reached and SQLite scans every row. Measured on a 200 000-row × 8-table measurements.db with a warm page cache: **196 ms per column**, and the column combo is editable, so ``currentTextChanged`` fires on every keystroke. Eight quick edits froze the window for **894 ms** in one unbroken block; ``set_source`` itself cost 183 ms and a single deliberate column choice 220 ms. With worker execution, the same three are 29 ms, 5 ms and 2 ms.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.row_exclusion#3
records.source: ``distinct_values`` runs one ``SELECT DISTINCT … LIMIT 501`` per ``(database, table)`` pair the chosen column appears in — and the columns a user actually excludes on (``plateID``, ``columnID``, ``rowID``) hold a handful of distinct values across the whole table, so the LIMIT is never reached and SQLite scans every row. Measured on a 200 000-row × 8-table measurements.db with a warm page cache: **196 ms per column**, and the column combo is editable, so ``currentTextChanged`` fires on every keystroke. Eight quick edits froze the window for **894 ms** in one unbroken block; ``set_source`` itself cost 183 ms and a single deliberate column choice 220 ms. Threaded, the same three are 29 ms, 5 ms and 2 ms.
records.translation: ``distinct_values`` 运行一 ``SELECT DISTINCT … LIMIT 501`` 为 ``(database, table)`` 选择的列出现在 — 并且一个用户实际上排除的列(``plateID``, ``columnID``, ``rowID``)在整个桌子上保持一堆不同的值,所以限制永远不会达到。 SQLite 每行扫描,测量为200000罗 × 8 桌子 measurements.db 用温暖的页面缓存: **196 ms 每列**,和列组合是可编辑的,所以 ``currentTextChanged`` 8个快速编辑冻结窗口 **第894章** 在一个不被打破的区块中。 ``set_source`` 它本身成本为183 ms,单个故意列选项为220 ms. 与工作进程执行相同的三个是29 ms,5 ms和2 ms。

records.context: Schema discovery and value reads get **separate** runners. :meth:`JobRunner.cancel` works by generation, so one runner cannot supersede a value read without also dropping the schema read that the value read depends on.

records.context: Two runners, not one: ``cancel`` abandons everything a runner has in flight, and superseding a keystroke's value read must not also abandon the schema read that says which databases the column even lives in.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.row_exclusion.RowExclusionEditor#7
records.source: Two runners, not one: ``cancel`` abandons everything a runner has in flight, and superseding a keystroke's value read must not also abandon the schema read that says which databases the column even lives in.
records.translation: 两个运行器,而不是一个: ``cancel`` 放弃所有一个运行器在飞行中,并超越一个关键字的价值阅读也不应该放弃图表阅读,说哪个数据库列甚至生活在其中。

records.context: Not the only line of defence, deliberately, because it is not always reached: this editor is a child inside a settings panel, and navigating away from that panel destroys it without any close event. What covers that case is the runner itself — the QThreads are unparented and retire themselves, and ``JobRunner._relay`` catches the ``RuntimeError`` PySide6 raises when a worker settles after its runner's C++ half has gone.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.row_exclusion.RowExclusionEditor.closeEvent#2
records.source: Not the only line of defence, deliberately, because it is not always reached: this editor is a child inside a settings panel, and navigating away from that panel destroys it without any close event. What covers that case is the runner itself — the QThreads are unparented and retire themselves, and ``JobRunner._relay`` catches the ``RuntimeError`` PySide6 raises when a worker settles after its runner's C++ half has gone.
records.translation: 不是唯一的防御线,故意,因为它并不总是达到:这个编辑器是一个孩子在一个设置面板内,从那个面板远导航破坏它没有任何接近的事件。 这个案例覆盖的是运行器本身 - QThreads 是无家可归的,退休自己,而 ``JobRunner._relay`` 抓住 ``RuntimeError`` PySide6 升起,当一个工作进程在运行器的 C++ 半已经消失后安排。

records.context: **A file that exists is not a file that finished.** Older versions of ``spacr.io._load_and_concatenate_arrays`` wrote ``merged/<field>.npy`` with a bare ``np.save`` straight onto the destination path, so a crash mid-write left a short, structurally valid-looking ``.npy`` on disk. Current versions write merged arrays atomically, but files left by earlier runs can still be truncated. A resume that skips on ``os.path.exists`` would accept such a field, measure whatever bytes happened to land, and put the result in the same table as the good fields. So :func:`completed_fields_in_merged` *validates*: it parses the ``.npy`` header and checks that the file is as long as its own shape claims. Anything short is reported as rejected and re-queued, never skipped.
records.label: spacr.resume#3
records.source: **A file that exists is not a file that finished.** Older versions of ``spacr.io._load_and_concatenate_arrays`` wrote ``merged/<field>.npy`` with a bare ``np.save`` straight onto the destination path, so a crash mid-write left a short, structurally valid-looking ``.npy`` on disk. Current versions write merged arrays atomically, but files left by earlier runs can still be truncated. A resume that skips on ``os.path.exists`` would accept such a field, measure whatever bytes happened to land, and put the result in the same table as the good fields. So :func:`completed_fields_in_merged` *validates*: it parses the ``.npy`` header and checks that the file is as long as its own shape claims. Anything short is reported as rejected and re-queued, never skipped.
records.translation: 存在的 **A 文件不是完成的文件** 旧版本的 ``spacr.io._load_and_concatenate_arrays`` 写了 ``merged/<field>.npy`` 与一个纯 ``np.save`` 直向目的地路径,所以一个崩溃的中间写留下一个短,结构上有效的 ``.npy`` 看起来在磁盘上。 目前的版本写合并的序列原子,但由以前的运行留下的文件仍然可以被打破。 一个重定向,在``os.path.exists``的船将接受这样的视野,测量任何比特发生在陆地,并将结果放在相同的表与好视野。 因此,:func:`completed_fields_in_merged` *validates*:它打破了``.npy``标题,并检查文件只要其自己的形状要求。 每件短暂的事情,都被拒绝和重复,从来没有被忽略。

records.context: **The measurement workflow appends rows, so existing rows must be removed prior to continuing an interrupted run.** ``_merge_and_save_to_database`` and ``filepaths_to_database`` both call ``to_sql(..., if_exists='append')``. Measuring a field again does not replace existing rows; it *inserts additional rows*. This makes downstream per-well aggregates too large without a warning. :func:`clear_field_rows` removes old rows so repeated measurement produces one consistent result. One transaction covers every affected table, so an error leaves the database unchanged.
records.label: spacr.resume#4
records.source: **Measure appends; therefore a resume must delete first.** ``_merge_and_save_to_database`` and ``filepaths_to_database`` both use ``to_sql(..., if_exists='append')``. Re-measuring a field that already wrote some rows does not overwrite them, it *adds* to them, and every per-well aggregate downstream is then computed over inflated counts with nothing anywhere to indicate it. :func:`clear_field_rows` is the delete-before-insert that makes re-running a field idempotent, and it is the reason this module exists at all. It runs in one transaction across every table the field touched, so a failure part-way leaves the database exactly as it was.
records.translation: **测量工作流添加行,因此在继续中断运行之前必须删除现有行。** ``_merge_and_save_to_database`` 和 ``filepaths_to_database`` 两者都呼叫 ``to_sql(..., if_exists='append')``. 再次测量一个字段不会取代现有的行; 它 *输入额外的行*. 这使得下流对孔集成太大,没有警告。 :func:`clear_field_rows` 删除旧行,所以重复测量产生一个一致的结果。

records.context: "Already measured" deliberately means *present in every table this processing session writes*, not "present somewhere". ``_measure_crop_core`` inserts into ``cell``, then ``nucleus``, then ``pathogen``, then ``cytoplasm``, then ``png_list``, one call after another with a commit each — so a process killed between two of those calls leaves a field that has cell rows and no nucleus rows. Counting that field as done would permanently lose its nuclei; counting it as pending without clearing it first would duplicate its cells. It is reported through ``partial`` so the caller can do the third, correct thing: clear it and execute it again.
records.label: spacr.resume.completed_fields_in_db#1
records.source: "Already measured" deliberately means *present in every table this run writes*, not "present somewhere". ``_measure_crop_core`` inserts into ``cell``, then ``nucleus``, then ``pathogen``, then ``cytoplasm``, then ``png_list``, one call after another with a commit each — so a process killed between two of those calls leaves a field that has cell rows and no nucleus rows. Counting that field as done would permanently lose its nuclei; counting it as pending without clearing it first would duplicate its cells. It is reported through ``partial`` so the caller can do the third, correct thing: clear it and re-run it.
records.translation: "Already measured" 故意意味着 *在每个表中,此处理会写*,而不是 "present somewhere"。 ``_measure_crop_core`` 插入 ``cell`` ,然后 ``nucleus`` ,然后 ``pathogen`` ,然后 ``cytoplasm`` ,然后 ``png_list`` ,一个接一个呼叫,每个接一个 - 因此,在两个呼叫之间死亡的过程留下一个有细胞行和没有核行的视野。 计算该视野如已将永久失去其细胞核; 计算它等待,而不清除它,首先将其细胞复制。 它是通过 ``partial`` 通知,所以呼叫者可以做第三,正确的事情:清理它,并重新执行它。

records.context: 1. *Did the run work?* — reads per microplate sample position and which microplate sample positions are starved, how many reads never mapped, whether the barcode references are distinguishable at all, whether a laboratory microplate row or column is systematically under-read, and how evenly the library is covered. 2. *Where do I cut?* — a gRNA is kept in a microplate sample position when its share of that microplate sample position's reads reaches an abundance threshold. Too low and a microplate sample position collects bleed-through guides it never contained, so no phenotype can be attributed to any one of them; too high and microplate sample positions lose the guides they did contain, and with them the statistical detection sensitivity of the screening experiment.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc#2
records.source: 1. *Did the run work?* — reads per well and which wells are starved, how many reads never mapped, whether the barcode references are distinguishable at all, whether a plate row or column is systematically under-read, and how evenly the library is covered. 2. *Where do I cut?* — a gRNA is kept in a well when its share of that well's reads reaches an abundance threshold. Too low and a well collects bleed-through guides it never contained, so no phenotype can be attributed to any one of them; too high and wells lose the guides they did contain, and with them the statistical power of the screen.
records.translation: 1. *在运行工作?* - 阅读按微板样本位置和什么微板模板位置是饥饿的,有多少阅读从未地图,是否条码参考是完全可区分的,是否实验室微板行或列是系统地下阅读,以及如何平等地图书馆被覆盖。 *在哪里我切割?* - 一 gRNA 保持在微板示板位置,当其份额的微板的样本姿势的阅读达到一个丰富的阈值。 样品位置失去了它们所包含的引导,随之而来的是筛选实验的统计检测灵敏度。

records.context: **Why a module of its own rather than more of** :mod:`spacr.sequencing`: that module is the read path — FASTQ in, count table out — and it is imported into every ``multiprocessing`` worker of a mapping run. The QC here is a separate, later job over the table that path produced; it pulls in plotting and statistics that the read workers must not pay for, and it is the piece a user re-runs a dozen times while choosing a threshold, long after the reads are mapped.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc#4
records.source: **Why a module of its own rather than more of** :mod:`spacr.sequencing`: that module is the read path — FASTQ in, count table out — and it is imported into every ``multiprocessing`` worker of a mapping run. records.translation: **为什么一个模块本身而不是更多的** :mod:`spacr.sequencing`:这个模块是阅读路径 - FASTQ 在,计算表 - 它被进口到每个 ``multiprocessing`` 工作者的地图运行。 QC 这里是一个单独的,后来的工作,在该路径产生的桌子上;它吸引在插图和统计,阅读工作者不需要支付,并且它是用户在选择一个阈值时重新运行几十次,很长一段时间后,阅读是地图。

records.context: This replaces choosing a cutoff by eye. records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.derive_threshold#1
records.source: This replaces choosing a cutoff by eye. The experimenter states the biological quantity — how many gRNAs a well is meant to carry, which is a design decision about power versus attributability — and the cutoff is whatever number delivers it *in this run's data*. Two runs at different depth get different numbers for the same target.
records.translation: 这取代了选择一个分支的眼睛. 实验室表示生物量 - 多少 gRNAs 一个微板样本位置是要携带的,这是一个设计决策的功率与可归性 - 和分支是任何数字提供它 *在这次运行的数据*. 两次运行在不同的深度获得不同的数字为相同的目标。

records.context: **The number returned sits in the middle of its plateau, not on its edge.** A whole range of thresholds gives the same gRNAs-per-microplate sample position answer — on a clean run that range is the empty space between the guides a microplate sample position really carried and the bleed-through tail below them, which is exactly what a histogram is being read for when a cutoff is picked by eye. Returning either edge of it would put the cutoff where a re-sequenced run or a rounded count flips guides across it. The geometric middle gives the same answer and is stable; both edges are reported as ``interval_low`` / ``interval_high`` so the width of the plateau — how much slack the choice has — is visible too.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.derive_threshold#3
records.source: **The number returned sits in the middle of its plateau, not on its edge.** A whole range of thresholds gives the same gRNAs-per-well answer — on a clean run that range is the empty space between the guides a well really carried and the bleed-through tail below them, which is exactly what a histogram is being read for when a cutoff is picked by eye. Returning either edge of it would put the cutoff where a re-sequenced run or a rounded count flips guides across it. The geometric middle gives the same answer and is stable; both edges are reported as ``interval_low`` / ``interval_high`` so the width of the plateau — how much slack the choice has — is visible too.
records.translation: **返回的座位在其板块的中间, 不在其边缘** 一个整个范围的边界给出相同的答案 gRNAs 每微板样本位置 - 在一个清洁的运行范围是引导 RNA之间的空白空间一个微板模型位置实际上携带,并在它们下方的流血的尾巴, 什么是正确的什么一个希斯托格拉姆在被眼睛收取时正在阅读。 返回它的边缘或边缘将放置尾巴,在那里一个重新序列的运行或一个圆形的计算流向它。 地质中间给出相同的答案,稳定; 两边都被称为 ``interval_low`` / ``interval_high`` 因此板块的宽度 - 选择有多少滑板 - 也是可见的。

records.context: Two stacked panels share one log-scaled threshold axis: gRNAs per well above, well retention and collision rate below. The derived threshold is a labelled vertical line carrying its own numeric value in both panels, so the derived value can be read without the axis.
