records.context: Four spaCR tiles currently share this landing page, but they answer different biological questions.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segments plaque images and summarizes plaque number and area.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` measures a fluorescent marker around pathogens or vacuoles relative to host cytoplasm. :func:`analyze_invasion` uses differential pre/post-permeabilization staining to classify parasites as attached outside or invaded inside a host cell. :func:`analyze_replication` counts parasites within each parasitophorous vacuole and compares the resulting replication-state distributions.  Cellpose training, testing, and model-application utilities also live here, but they are not substitutes for those four assay entry points.
records.label: spacr.submodules#2
records.source: Four spaCR tiles currently share this landing page, but they answer different biological questions.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segments plaque images and summarizes plaque number and area.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` measures a fluorescent marker around pathogens or vacuoles relative to host cytoplasm. :func:`analyze_invasion` uses differential pre/post-permeabilization staining to classify parasites as attached outside or invaded inside a host cell. :func:`analyze_replication` counts parasites within each parasitophorous vacuole and compares the resulting replication-state distributions.  Cellpose training, testing, and model-application utilities also live here, but they are not substitutes for those four assay entry points.
records.translation: 目前有四个 spaCR 磁贴共用此入口页面，但它们回答不同的生物学问题。 :func:`analyze_plaques` 分割蚀斑图像，并汇总蚀斑数量和面积。 :func:`analyze_recruitment` 测量病原体或液泡周围相对于宿主细胞质的荧光标记物。:func:`analyze_invasion` 利用透化前/后的差异染色，将寄生虫分类为附着在宿主细胞外或已入侵到宿主细胞内。:func:`analyze_replication` 统计每个纳虫泡内的寄生虫数，并比较由此得到的复制状态分布。 Cellpose 训练、测试和模型应用工具也位于此处，但它们不能替代这四个检测入口。

records.context: Plaque analysis writes ``<src>/masks/plaques_analysis.db`` with ``summary``, ``stats``, and ``details`` tables.  Recruitment returns per-object and per-well DataFrames and writes their CSVs and plots.  Invasion returns per-parasite classifications, per-microscope field of view thresholds and QC, per-well efficiencies, condition summaries and comparisons, controls, and figures; saved runs place those artifacts under ``results/analyze_invasion``. Replication returns per-vacuole counts, well and condition distributions, pairwise and omnibus statistics, figures, and the grouping method actually used, with saved output under ``results/analyze_replication``.  Model utilities produce trained weights, evaluation tables, masks, and object summaries as appropriate.
records.label: spacr.submodules#6
records.source: Plaque analysis writes ``<src>/masks/plaques_analysis.db`` with ``summary``, ``stats``, and ``details`` tables.  Recruitment returns per-object and per-well DataFrames and writes their CSVs and plots.  Invasion returns per-parasite classifications, per-field thresholds and QC, per-well efficiencies, condition summaries and comparisons, controls, and figures; saved runs place those artifacts under ``results/analyze_invasion``. Replication returns per-vacuole counts, well and condition distributions, pairwise and omnibus statistics, figures, and the grouping method actually used, with saved output under ``results/analyze_replication``.  Model utilities produce trained weights, evaluation tables, masks, and object summaries as appropriate.
records.translation: 板块分析 写作 ``<src>/masks/plaques_analysis.db`` 与 ``summary``, ``stats``,和 ``details`` 招聘回归为对象和对孔 DataFrames 写下他们的 CSVs 侵入返回对寄生虫的分类,对显微镜的视野阈值和 QC, per-well 效率,条件总结和比较,控制,和数字; 保存的运行地点 这些物品在下方 ``results/analyze_invasion``复制返回每个液泡计算,福和条件分布,双式和 omnibus 统计数据,数字,以及实际使用的组合方法,与节省的产量下 ``results/analyze_replication``. 模型工具根据适当情况生产训练权重、评估表、掩膜和对象摘要。

records.context: The rows come from :func:`spacr.io._read_and_merge_data`, which collapses the per-object ``pathogen`` table onto the **host cell** (``prcfo`` is built from ``cell_id``). ``pathogen_area`` on each row is therefore the *sum* of the areas of every pathogen object inside that host cell — one host cell carrying two parasitophorous vacuoles contributes a single row holding the combined area of both.

records.source: The rows come from :func:`spacr.io._read_and_merge_data`, which collapses the per-object ``pathogen`` table onto the **host cell** (``prcfo`` is built from ``cell_id``). ``pathogen_area`` on each row is therefore the *sum* of the areas of every pathogen object inside that host cell — one host cell carrying two parasitophorous vacuoles contributes a single row holding the combined area of both.
records.translation: 行源于 :func:`spacr.io._read_and_merge_data`,它将对对象的``pathogen``表崩溃到 **宿主细胞**(``prcfo``是从 ``cell_id``构成的)。 ``pathogen_area``在每个行中因此是每个病原体的区域的 *sum* 在该主细节内 - 一个主细体携带两个寄生虫的空气有助于一个单一行,保持两者的组合区域。

records.source: Nothing here counts parasites. A bin is a doubling of *area-derived size*, which tracks parasites-per-vacuole only while the pathogen mask segments whole vacuoles and each host cell holds exactly one.

records.context: **The threshold is per microscope field of view.** Illumination and staining vary microscope field of view to microscope field of view, and a laboratory microplate-wide cut turns an illumination gradient into an invasion gradient. See :func:`_invasion_field_thresholds`.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#6
records.source: **The threshold is per field.** Illumination and staining vary field to field, and a plate-wide cut turns an illumination gradient into an invasion gradient. See :func:`_invasion_field_thresholds`.
records.translation: **阈值按视野确定。** 光照和染色因视野而异，而整板统一的截断会把光照梯度变成入侵梯度。参见 :func:`_invasion_field_thresholds`。

records.context: **Controls take precedence over the automatic method.** ``control_wells`` names microplate sample positions whose parasites are known to carry no outside stain; the threshold is then a high quantile of that negative distribution (``control_quantile``), the control microplate sample positions are excluded from the results, and ``threshold_source`` says ``'control'`` so the report cannot be mistaken for an automatic run.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#7
records.source: **Controls take precedence over the automatic method.** ``control_wells`` names wells whose parasites are known to carry no outside stain; the threshold is then a high quantile of that negative distribution (``control_quantile``), the control wells are excluded from the results, and ``threshold_source`` says ``'control'`` so the report cannot be mistaken for an automatic run.
records.translation: **对照优先于自动方法。** ``control_wells`` 指定已知其寄生虫不带外部染色的孔；此时阈值取该阴性分布的高分位数（``control_quantile``），对照孔会从结果中排除，并且 ``threshold_source`` 显示为 ``'control'``，因此报告不会被误认为是自动方法得出的。

records.context: *Toxoplasma gondii* replicates by endodyogeny, two daughters forming inside a mother, so a parasitophorous vacuole holds 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 parasites — a power of two. The readout of a replication assay is therefore the **distribution** of parasites-per-vacuole across a microplate sample position, not a mean: a mean of 3.2 cannot distinguish "everything at 3-ish", which is biologically impossible, from a healthy mix of 2s and 4s. A drug that slows replication moves mass from the 8 and 4 buckets down into 2 and 1, and only the distribution shows that.

records.translation: *Toxoplasma gondii*由内分子复制,两个女儿在母亲内部形成, 因此,寄生虫有1、2、4、8或16个寄生虫。 — 因此,复制测试的重定向是对微板样本位置的**分布**的寄生虫,而不是中间。: 3.2 的平均值不能区分 "everything at 3-ish", 生物不可能的,从健康的混合2和4的药物减缓复制,从8和4个泡沫的质量移动到2和1。, 只有分销才会证明这一点。

records.context: 1. A suggestion is never confusable with a decision. Suggestions are stored as their own values -- a suggested 1 becomes 11 -- so nothing that reads the annotation column can mistake one for a human's answer, and a processing session that goes wrong is undone by deleting a value rather than by remembering which rows were touched. 2. A suggestion never overwrites an annotation. Writes carry ``IS NULL``. Not when the model is confident, not on a repeat execution. A human's labels are the ground truth the model was fitted on; losing one silently would cost hours and would not be noticed until a processing session came out wrong. 3. There is no confidence floor; the order carries the uncertainty. Every unannotated extracted image region gets a suggestion, sorted most-confident first, and the reviewer stops where they stop agreeing. A threshold would make that decision with an arbitrary number. 4. A judgement is recorded, not inferred. Confirming a suggestion turns it into an ordinary label and rejecting one clears it -- and both are written down beside the column, in ``<column>_verdict``, as the class that was confirmed (``+c``) or rejected (``-c``). A rejection is information the next round can train on -- "not class 1" is an example of class 2 in a two-class column -- whereas a NULL would record nothing. The verdict column is added the first time a source is opened, so tables made before it existed gain it without a migration step.
records.label: spacr.suggest#4

A suggestion never overwrites an annotation. Writes carry ``IS NULL``. Not when the model is confident, not on a re-run. A human's labels are the ground truth the model was fitted on; losing one silently would cost hours and would not be noticed until a run came out wrong. 3. A rejection is information the next round can train on -- "not class 1" is an example of class 2 in a two-class column -- whereas a NULL would record nothing. The verdict column is added the first time a source is opened, so tables made before it existed gain it without a migration step.
records.translation: 1. 提议永远不会与决策混淆. 提示是存储为自己的值 - 一个提议 1 变成 11 - 因此,没有什么读到标记列可以错误一个为一个人的答案,而一个错误的处理会议是通过删除一个值而不是记住哪些行被触摸。 2. 一个提示永远不会过写一个标记. 写作携带 ``IS NULL``. 不是当模型是自信的,不是在一个重复执行。 每个未提交的图像区域都会得到一个提示,分类最有信心的第一,评论家停止在他们停止同意的地方. 一个阈值会使这个决定有意义的数字. 4. 一个判决被记录,而不是结论. 证明一个提示将它变成一个常见的标签,并拒绝一个清除它 - 两者都写下在列旁边,在 ``<column>_verdict``,因为被证明(``+c``)或被拒绝(``-c``)。 一个拒绝是下一轮可以训练的信息 - "not class 1"是一个例子的二级在一个二级列 - 因为一个 NULL不会记录任何东西。

records.translation: **不同长度的运行从来没有调整过。** 每个系列都由其自己的轮次轴组成。 打破一个60 个轮次的运行过程,以匹配一个25 个轮次的邻居,发明一个结果("B never got better") 并发明另一个; 传说显示了运行过程的长度。

records.context: **k-fold runs keep their folds.** ``folds='per_fold'`` (the default) draws every fold; ``folds='mean'`` draws the fold mean with a ±1 sd band and labels it ``mean of k folds ±sd``; ``folds='both'`` draws both. A mean curve rendered as if it were a single run hides precisely the fold-to-fold variance k-fold was added to expose — and because folds can stop at different epochs (early stopping), the mean carries an ``n_folds`` column so a tail computed from two of five folds is visible rather than implied.
records.label: spacr.train_compare#11
records.source: **k-fold runs keep their folds.** ``folds='per_fold'`` (the default) draws every fold; ``folds='mean'`` draws the fold mean with a ±1 sd band and labels it ``mean of k folds ±sd``; ``folds='both'`` draws both. A mean curve rendered as if it were a single run hides precisely the fold-to-fold variance k-fold was added to expose — and because folds can stop at different epochs (early stopping), the mean carries an ``n_folds`` column so a tail computed from two of five folds is visible rather than implied.
records.translation: **k-fold 运行保持其字段.** ``folds='per_fold'`` (默认) 拖动每个字段; ``folds='mean'`` 用 ±1 sd 带提取中间,并标记 ``mean of k folds ±sd``; ``folds='both'`` 吸引两者。 一个中间曲线呈现,好像它是一个单一的旋转隐藏了正确的折叠到折叠的变量 k-fold 被添加到曝光 - 并且由于折叠可以停止在不同的轮次(早期停止),中间携带一个 ``n_folds`` 列,因此从两个五个折叠计算的尾巴是可见的而不是暗示的。

records.context: **Stitching 2-D image layers is not 3-D segmentation.** Both are legitimate and they give different answers. Per-image-layer segmentation followed by IoU linking (:data:`MODE_STITCH`) sees each image layer independently and cannot recover an object that is invisible in one image layer; true volumetric segmentation (:data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC`) uses the z gradient but is far more sensitive to a wrong anisotropy. The mode is therefore explicit, never inferred, and :class:`ZStackResult` records which one actually ran so it can be written next to the numbers it produced.
records.label: spacr.zstack#5
records.source: **Stitching 2-D planes is not 3-D segmentation.** Both are legitimate and they give different answers. Per-plane segmentation followed by IoU linking (:data:`MODE_STITCH`) sees each plane independently and cannot recover an object that is invisible in one plane; true volumetric segmentation (:data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC`) uses the z gradient but is far more sensitive to a wrong anisotropy. The mode is therefore explicit, never inferred, and :class:`ZStackResult` records which one actually ran so it can be written next to the numbers it produced.
records.translation: **Stitching 2D 图像层不是 3D 分割.** 两者都是合法的,并提供不同的答案。 图像层分割,随之而来的IoU链接(:data:`MODE_STITCH`)可以独立看到每层图像,并且无法恢复在图像一层中看不见的对象; 真正的量子分割(:data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC`)使用 z 格拉迪因,但对错误的无神论更敏感。 因此,模式是明确的,从来没有结论,并且:class:`ZStackResult`记录,一个实际上运行,所以它可以写在它产生的数字旁边。

records.context: A z-stack is ``n_z`` times a microscope field of view, and volumetric segmentation transiently needs several copies of it. :func:`estimate_peak_bytes` gives the number for a given microscope field of view; the workflow processes **one microscope field of view at a time** and never holds a laboratory microplate. For a 2048x2048 microscope field of view at 21 image layers in float32 that is ~350 MB for the volume, and ~1.4 GB peak in :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC` with resampling at anisotropy 5 (the isotropic copy is ``anisotropy`` times taller). This is why :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC` is not the default.
records.label: spacr.zstack#9
records.source: A z-stack is ``n_z`` times a field, and volumetric segmentation transiently needs several copies of it. :func:`estimate_peak_bytes` gives the number for a given field; the pipeline processes **one field at a time** and never holds a plate. For a 2048x2048 field at 21 planes in float32 that is ~350 MB for the volume, and ~1.4 GB peak in :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC` with resampling at anisotropy 5 (the isotropic copy is ``anisotropy`` times taller). This is why :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC` is not the default.
records.translation: 一个 z-stack 是 ``n_z`` 次一个显微镜的视野,而量子分割过渡需要几个副本的它. :func:`estimate_peak_bytes` 给了一个显微镜的视场的数字; 工作流程过程 **一个显显微观的视角在一个时间** 并且从来没有一个实验室显微板. 对于一个 2048x2048 显微光的视线在 21 图像层在 float32 这是 ~350 MB 的容量, 和 ~1.4 GB 的顶峰在 :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC` 与重新照明在 anisotropy 5 (以色列的副本是``anisotropy`` 倍高)。 这就是为什么 :data:`MODE_VOLUMETRIC` 不是默认的。

records.context: The default ingest route, ``spacr.io._rename_and_organize_image_files``, collapses z before any array reaches segmentation. With ``z_stack=True`` and ``z_segmentation_mode='volumetric'``, :func:`spacr.io.preprocess_img_data` uses a separate raw TIFF route that keeps z, and ``spacr.measure`` accepts ``(Z, Y, X)`` label volumes. :func:`plan_from_settings` returns ``None`` whenever the 3D settings are off -- which is the default -- so the 2-D path is untouched, and :mod:`spacr.object` raises :class:`ZAxisNotPresentError` rather than projecting when the settings are on but the batch it receives has no z axis.
records.label: spacr.zstack#11
records.source: The default ingest route, ``spacr.io._rename_and_organize_image_files``, collapses z before any array reaches segmentation. With ``z_stack=True`` and ``z_segmentation_mode='volumetric'``, :func:`spacr.io.preprocess_img_data` uses a separate raw TIFF route that keeps z, and ``spacr.measure`` accepts ``(Z, Y, X)`` label volumes. :func:`plan_from_settings` returns ``None`` whenever the 3D settings are off -- which is the default -- so the 2-D path is untouched, and :mod:`spacr.object` raises :class:`ZAxisNotPresentError` rather than projecting when the settings are on but the batch it receives has no z axis.
records.translation: 默认输入路径, ``spacr.io._rename_and_organize_image_files``, z 崩溃之前任何序列到达分割. 与 ``z_stack=True`` 和 ``z_segmentation_mode='volumetric'``, :func:`spacr.io.preprocess_img_data` 使用一个单独的原始 TIFF 路径保持 z, 并 ``spacr.measure`` 接受 ``(Z, Y, X)`` 标签容量. :func:`plan_from_settings` 返回 ``None`` 每当 3D 设置关闭 - 这是默认的 - 因此 2-D 路线是无触摸的, 并且 :mod:`spacr.object` 提高 :class:`ZAxisNotPresentError` 而不是在设置时投影,但收到的包没有 z 轴。

records.context: Each timepoint goes to :func:`spacr.zstack.segment_3d` with this spec's z settings, so the per-timepoint behaviour is *identical* to a 3-D run and the two cannot drift apart. Segmentation is deliberately per-timepoint and independent: linking is a separate decision made by :func:`track_4d`, and fusing the two is what makes a tracker's mistakes indistinguishable from a segmenter's.
